Simulation. The search saves an offset; it is not a trained robot policy.

INTERACTIVE SOFTWARE PROTOTYPE

Inside the simulation.

A tool pushes a connector into a socket. MuJoCo works out the motion and forces in your browser.

The search
If the plug hits, it backs off and tries a little to each side. When one spot works, it keeps it. It never sees where the socket is. This is a fixed search, not a learned skill.
The checks
Connected means the plug went in deep enough. Locked means it held when pulled. You can force either to fail. There is no real wiring or latch.
The limits
Sizes and forces are made up. Only the plug and socket touch; everything else is for show. No camera, no cables, no wear, no real robot. Reset pulls the same plug back out.
